purpose: D16-19 requires any negative-sample proposal to prove the negative is inside the candidate pool before it may spend training budget

design.twin_definition: swap two non-overlapping spans of the gold key; same character length and same UTF-8 byte multiset; the result must be another key of the same pool
design.entity_restricted_definition: same, but both spans must be entity strings of the world (descriptions and names)
design.margin_rule: only twins that are in the pool and compete in argmax would be scored; there are none, so nothing is scored

pool_correction.evidence: len(fixture['record_keys']) == 8 for 832 fixtures; score_rows appends one null row, so the scored tensor has 9 rows
pool_correction.consequence: 后半段所有比例以 8 条池计算；12 为笔误，写回 ledger 16.12

generate_from_records.mechanism: the live key is the record description; after a description/name swap inside the raw line, the first entity is either the same description (duplicate key, byte-identical score) or the name (never a pool key), so no distinct in-pool key appears
generate_from_records.cross_record_mechanism: swapping descriptions between records permutes the same 8 strings, so the key set is unchanged; swapping names never touches the key

margin.reason: in-pool twins = 0, so score_gold - score_twin has an empty measurement set; no bundle was loaded and no forward pass was spent
margin.identity_statement: any twin that preserves the gold description key has score difference exactly 0 (identical key bytes); any twin whose key leaves the description pool is out-of-pool by definition (D16-19)

verdict.next_step_only: 只许做：若仍要测顺序敏感选择，必须另立“数据前提”提案（把候选 key 从描述改为整行、并把 8 条池扩成描述×名字的叉积），提案中必须写明孪生的池内编号、与 gold 的 key 字节差、以及当前 score_gold − score_twin 实测分布；禁止在现有 8 条候选池上再提池外负样本，禁止改 readout 判据。
verdict.scope: 只回答“池内对手是否存在”，不回答“训练能否学会”
